meeting.title: Meeting Sarthi
meeting.who: For work calls: client calls, stand-ups and project reviews.
features: When a client or your manager asks something on a call, Meeting Sarthi shows what to say, from your own notes and files.
After the call: a short recap, the client's open questions as to-dos, and a follow-up message you can send.
Before the call: what they may ask and what to say, from your notes and documents.
Live captions of the call, and log updates by voice, like 'ticket 151 moves to Meena, due Friday'.
meeting.note: On the Microsoft Store now. Captions and recaps are free.
